# webhook.co

> A free, permanent, signed webhook URL. Capture the webhooks other services send you — inspect them, verify their signatures, and replay them to localhost — then reliably deliver them onward or hand your agents an event they can act on. Reachable identically from a CLI, an API, the web, and an MCP server.

webhook.co is open-core webhook infrastructure: receive, inspect, replay-to-localhost, and reliably deliver webhooks. Signing and verification follow the Standard Webhooks spec, for both send and receive. This file indexes the pages most useful to a person — or an agent — trying to understand what webhook.co does. The full product reference lives in the docs.

## Product

- [Capture and replay](https://www.webhook.co/product/capture-replay): capture every request whole — headers, body, exact bytes — and replay any one of them to localhost as often as you need.
- [Signature verification](https://www.webhook.co/product/verification): verify inbound webhook signatures against the Standard Webhooks spec and per-provider schemes.
- [Delivery](https://www.webhook.co/product/delivery): reliable outbound delivery with retries and a dead-letter queue.
- [Agent triggers](https://www.webhook.co/product/agent-triggers): turn an incoming webhook into an event an agent can act on.
- [Pricing](https://www.webhook.co/pricing): single-dimension pricing on events, disclosed up front, with a soft cap that pauses rather than surprises.

## Tools

- [Test webhooks locally](https://www.webhook.co/test): point a provider's webhooks at a permanent URL, stream them to localhost, and replay them while you fix the handler.
- [Verify a webhook signature](https://www.webhook.co/verify): check a signature against its payload and secret for 120+ providers, entirely in your browser — nothing you paste leaves the page.
- [Test Stripe webhooks locally](https://www.webhook.co/test/stripe): register the endpoint, trigger a real event, and debug signature verification against the live engine.
- [Test GitHub webhooks locally](https://www.webhook.co/test/github)
- [Test Shopify webhooks locally](https://www.webhook.co/test/shopify)
